entries.title: Quantum Break
entries.definitive_edition: Quantum Break Steam / Timeless Collector's Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the Steam PC build and confirm episode playback is working before streaming.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Native PC presentation with Steam compatibility advantages.

primary.why: The Steam Windows PC release is the best route because it includes the full game and integrated live-action episode structure while avoiding the older Windows Store/UWP-only limitations; the Steam version runs on Windows 7+ while the Microsoft Store version requires Windows 10+.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Quantum Break on Steam and play the Windows PC build. Keep the episode video files/streaming path available so the live-action episodes play between acts.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is documented; prefer the Steam PC release over the older UWP build for compatibility.
